work.author: Gregorius Papa XV,
work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. LXXVI heading/synopsis 98568–98575 and explicit protocol 98577–98578 precede the preamble and ordered §§1–3. Retain the synopsis note 98583–98586 and marked-word note 98645. The act’s own dating clause and printed date are 98671–98675, before the separate LXXVII heading 98678 and protocol 98689. Add note 98705 as a separate range: its reading tenorem comments on the marked tenores at 98655 in LXXVI, although the note is printed after the next act’s introductory body. Context through 98725 was read; the next act’s heading, protocol, body and subsequent Clement VIII marginalia are excluded. No body-column reversal was found.
